name: [🎄] Ultimate Town Multiplayer
desc:
THIS GAME IS STILL IN BETA AND HAS MANY FEATURES MISSING OR UNFINISHED!

This game is a multiplayer version of Ultimate Town Sandbox, another InfiniDev game.

🗺️ Explore the town of Vitex with your friends! You can now meet NPCs, work jobs, fight enemies, cause explosions, drive vehicles, fly helicopters, dumpster dive, harvest plants, and so much more, together!

🎮 Controls can be found by pressing the controller icon in the inventory.
For controller/console, press Select to access the virtual cursor.

🏆 Premium players get +5 Gems per playtime reward, and +25% XP and Gems overall.

Tags: Town, Roleplay, City, Jobs, Houses, Vehicles, Cars, Boats, Helicopters, Police, Moods, Inventory, NPC, FPS, Enemies, Customization, Multiplayer
